configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared by both toolchains. binaryDir is deliberately absent here and supplied by each concrete preset instead: the four build trees must never overlap, or clangd will suddenly be reading a compile_commands.json produced by the other compiler.

configurePresets.name: clang-base
configurePresets.description: Note these are unqualified clang / clang++, resolved from PATH. If another LLVM is installed (C:/LLVM, say), whichever comes first on PATH wins, and one that is too old hits STL1000 against a recent MSVC STL. To pin it, replace these two with absolute paths right here.

configurePresets.name: msvc-base
configurePresets.description: CFLAGS / CXXFLAGS go through the environment rather than CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS: CMake splices those in front of the platform defaults (/DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /EHsc), whereas setting the cache variable directly would displace them. Neither switch is a matter of taste. artichoco/core/log.h uses the C++20 __VA_OPT__, which MSVC's traditional preprocessor does not know, so without /Zc:preprocessor every ARTI_ASSERT raises C3861. And the sources are BOM-less UTF-8: without /utf-8 they are read in the ANSI codepage (936/GBK on this machine), which is not merely the stream of C4819 warnings on the Chinese comments -- UTF-8 lead bytes mis-paired as GBK double bytes desynchronize and swallow whichever ASCII character follows.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Default development configuration; compile_commands.json lands in build/ for clangd.

configurePresets.name: msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: Must be run from an x64 Native Tools Command Prompt or Launch-VsDevShell.ps1: cl.exe finds its headers and libraries through INCLUDE / LIB / LIBPATH, none of which a plain shell has. It earns its keep by re-checking with MSVC's diagnostics what clang waved through, and by still building when the clang toolchain is broken.

configurePresets.name: msvc-release
configurePresets.description: Same as msvc-debug; needs a Developer Command Prompt.
